title: Evolution Simulation
description: 2 captured saves. One original BASIC player; historical bugs remain.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: EVOLUTION SIMULATION
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines, consistent pointers, normal end marker; exact both-channel matches; runtime untested

2 CLEAR 300
3 DEFDBL A,B,D-Z
4 A=RND(0)
5 CLS
6 S=1:T=1:F=1:GOTO10

10 '
17 A=RND(0)
20 E=RND(0)

versions.startupSource:
2 CLEAR 300
3 DEFDBL A,B,D-Z
5 CLS
6 S=1:T=1:F=1:GOTO10
7 INPUT"CHANCE OF SMALL CHANGE,CHANGE OF TOTAL CHANGE,CHANGE IN MATCH UP WINDOW,FLEX OF SPEICES, INTIAL MATCH UP WINDOW";S,T,W,F,I:CLS
10 FOR C=1TO10
17 A(C)=RND(0)
20 E(C)=RND(0)
25 NEXT
30 G=G+1
40 PRINT@896,F;G;
45 M=1
